name: av_macd
description:
MACD (moving average convergence divergence) for one stock from Alpha Vantage (MACD) computed on closing prices.
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Technical Analysis: MACD"} keyed by date or timestamp, each with MACD, MACD_Signal, MACD_Hist.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly; default daily).
Use it for trend and momentum crossovers, with Alpha Vantage's default 12/26/9 periods; av_ema for a single average. Raw prices: av_stock_daily.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "interval": "daily"}

interval.description: Bar interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly
